blocks.text: Next to that diploma on the wall, the one mark of distinction that most Filipinos value is public office—even just within one’s neighborhood. Which explains why barangay positions are just as prized—and fought over—as national posts. The latest proposed postponement of the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) thus comes both as blessing and bane—for […]... Keep on reading: Why postpone the BSKE again?
